summary: A Yes vote imposes a tax of up to 10% on the gross receipts of cannabis businesses operating in the city.

tax.text: A Yes vote enacts a tax of up to 10% on cannabis businesses operating in the city, potentially generating revenue for City services.
tax.quote: The measure would establish a tax of up to 10% of gross receipts on cannabis businesses operating in the City.

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the proposed cannabis business tax or generate this additional revenue for City services.
